course_name_original: Euskara para la ciencia y la técnica (GMN202)

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of mechanical engineering.
Ability to operate in complex situations or those requiring the development of new solutions both in the academic and professional fields within their area of study.

That students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds on general secondary education, and is typically at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes some aspects involving knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

That students have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (normally within their field of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific or ethical issues.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and using correct language, in writing.
Define the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, and using correct language orally.

syllabus_topics: Physico-mathematical expressions: orthotypography, writing, and reading-interpretation
teaching_methods: Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or checkpoints
Teacher's presentation in the classroom, in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject

assessment_rules: Individual written and oral tests assess technical competencies, with a 100% weight. For recovery, individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject are provided.
